_: The stadium's direction WHILE A MATCH IS ON. Every shot is a static camera authored in venue.json, so every change of shot is a cut and nothing in frame moves but the match — RFL's encoder is CBR, and a slow camera move spends bitrate on every pixel of every frame. The main camera holds about three quarters of the time, the way a gallery would. Between matches /broadcast runs live-cutlist.json instead, which is allowed to fly.
